p.headline: Principal @ Walter P Moore | Head of Design (INDIA) | Office Director (Structural Engineering, Bengaluru)
p.about:
Abhishek is a Principal and Head of Design at Walter P Moore, an international engineering team of solvers. Fueled by our collective expertise, technology, imagination and passion, we pursue answers to many of the world’s toughest challenges to deliver on the promise of a better built environment. 

Abhishek also leads the firms Bengaluru operations as an Office Director and is a Chartered Engineer with over 22 years of experience in designing, modeling, analyzing, and detailing of reinforced concrete, post tensioned and structural steel structures for various market sectors and geographies.

He is a proactive and strong communicator who leads and delivers projects of different sizes and scopes, from retail and commercial to healthcare and sports facilities. He has contributed to over 80 million sq. ft. of built space across the world (including India), with a focus on seismic design and analytical modeling. He is an excellent client server with complete project life cycles experience, including technical audits, quality control, statutory compliances and MEP/Architectural coordination for integrated delivery. He is passionate about creating innovative and sustainable solutions that enhance the built environment.

Abhishek as an escalation, technical liaison to individuals within and outside their organization. Preparation of weekly, monthly and quarterly productivity and project progress reports, monitoring of team members (including fresh graduates) and imparting regular training for increasing internal productivity, and proof checking of all design and detailing outputs as generated by team members before delivery to clients. publications.title: Seismic performance of multi-storey RC SMRF and OMRF buildings
publications.description: Abstract - Reinforced concrete moment resisting frames are one of the widely used lateral load resisting systems. Special moment resisting frames (SMRF s) are known for its enhanced ductility capacity and used for the same in high seismic risk zones. In this study, performance assessment of multi-storey RC special moment resisting frames (SMRF s) and ordinary moment resisting frames (OMRF s) is presented to compare the base shear capacity and ductility of the buildings using SAP2000 software. The nonlinear static analysis i.e. pushover analysis is adopted for studying the behaviour of SMRFs and OMRFs. The effect of infill walls are also taken into account in terms of base shear and roof displacement. The buildings response reduction factors are obtained from the capacity curves obtained for each modelled building by studying its behaviour parameters such as overstrength factor and ductility reduction factor. The FEM A P695 methodology is used to calculate response reduction factors.

p.headline: Managing Director, CCBA Designs
p.about:
Ramprasad Akkisetti has made a significant mark in the world of architecture and art through his firm, CCBA Designs, which he founded in Pune in 1995. As the Managing Director, alongside the late Prof. Christopher Benninger, Ramprasad transformed CCBA Designs from a modest beginning to an intellectual powerhouse in architecture and planning in India.

Ramprasad's journey began with medical studies at the Armed Forces Medical College in Pune, on track to become an doctor in the Indian Armed Forces. However, his true passion emerged in the field of design when he met Prof. Christopher Benninger, a renowned architect and planner from Harvard and MIT who had settled in Pune. This encounter led him to shift his focus from medicine to architecture. After dropping out of medical school, he pursued a Master's in Psychology and co-founded CCBA Designs alongside. In the early years, Ramprasad also taught psychology at Fergusson College and authored a book, Psychology for Beginners in 1997, which became a popular reference for students in the late 90s.

As Managing Director of CCBA Designs, Ramprasad has led the firm for nearly three decades, driving its growth and success. He closely monitors the aesthetics of each project and and works tirelessly to keep the firm’s legacy alive. Under his leadership, CCBA Designs won multiple prestigious awards, including the IIA Excellence in Architecture Award six times, the IIA Gold Medal, the Great Master Architect Award, and American Institute of Architects Awards and a nomination for the Aga Khan Awards for Architecture. Throughout his career, Ramprasad’s deep bond with his mentor, Prof. Benninger, has been a guiding force in his work. His global experiences, having traveled to over 50 countries, have enriched his design philosophy and allowed him to develop unique techniques. Ramprasad has led teams on major projects like IIT Hyderabad, IIM Calcutta, Azim Premji University, Bajaj Institute of Technology, the Supreme Court of Bhutan, and Lodha Belmondo, nurturing a workforce which upholds the highest standards of design excellence. 

Beyond architecture, Ramprasad is deeply committed to education and mentorship. He mentors students visiting India House from architecture colleges across the country and has made philanthropic contributions, including supporting an ambidextrous school in Central India. He has instituted several scholarships and gold medals in the honor of his late mentor Prof. Benninger, encouraging architecture students to aim for excellence.

p.headline: Founder and MD @ A Square Architects | Architecture | Project Management
p.about:
As the Founder and Managing Director of A Square Architects, established in 2008, I have had the privilege of leading one of Pune’s most trusted architectural design and liaisoning firms. With over 15 years in the industry, I am deeply passionate about creating innovative, functional, and sustainable spaces that stand as lasting legacies. Our firm has successfully completed over 700 projects, ranging across residential, commercial, industrial, and township sectors, providing comprehensive end-to-end solutions that cover everything from land selection and architectural planning to statutory approvals, supervision, interior design, and 3D visualization.

At A Square Architects, we pride ourselves on delivering high-quality, cost-effective, and personalized services that meet the unique needs of each client. Our dedicated team of 20 professionals, including architects, designers, engineers, and liaison officers, works collaboratively to ensure every project is executed to the highest standards of design excellence and regulatory compliance.

I am committed to fostering innovation, sustainable architecture, and client satisfaction, consistently striving to blend aesthetics with practicality while optimizing resources. Our role goes beyond design; we act as trusted advisors, guiding clients through every phase from concept to completion to ensure seamless project delivery.

Additionally, as the President of the Association Of Architectural Designers Maharashtra since 2019, I have had the opportunity to contribute to the professional development of architects across the state by promoting architectural excellence, best practices, and industry networking.

This journey is built on a foundation of creativity, integrity, and a relentless pursuit of excellence, shaping spaces that inspire and endure for generations.

A passionate practitioner of strategic design and a thought leader in Corporate Interior Architecture with over 23 years of experience, I have defined a career in workplace innovation by constantly seeking to explore new ways of embedding emerging trends shaping our industry through multiple design projects in India.

► I am deeply interested in understanding the changing nature of work and shaping the future workplace to deliver a design that is informed, purposeful and innovative. Change, generations at play, all things anthropological that impact the nature of work deeply inspire me towards shaping a future workplace that is informed, purposeful and innovative.

Leadership skills include Workplace Design & Strategy, Stakeholder Management [bridging the gap between global RE leaders and local delivery teams], cultivating best global practices for design innovation and project delivery, network building skills, managing P&L, and shaping sales strategies.

►A huge believer in Vulnerable leadership, I am constantly engaging and empowering colleagues to unleash future leaders and aim to empower my fellow travelers with new design & delivery technologies to leverage the power of data and analytics.
